Name: Aquarium Overhaul
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Aquarium Overhaul[/b][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/u][size=3]
Adds configurable animations to fish.
Adds static reskins for fish.
Changed the Halibut to be a flatfish.
Adds 28 new viable vanilla items for the Furniture Fish Tanks. [b]Decorations does not work with SVE.
[/b]Several decorations have configurable animations.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/O4syfvY.gif[/img][/center]Items that can now be added to the tanks:
[spoiler]
Dried Starfish
Rainbow Shell
Nautilus Shell
Pearl
Coconut
Golden Coconut
Pineapple
Magma Cap
Sandstone (turns into a Sand Castle)
Chipped Amphora
Driftwood
Hardwood
Anchor
Treasure Chest
Golden Pumpkin
Prismatic Shard
Green Algae
White Algae
Ocean Stone
Wood
Mermaid's Pendant
Ancient Sword
Prehistoric Skull
Nautilus Fossil
Prehistoric Tibia
Dragon Tooth
Artifact Trove
Diamond
[/spoiler]

[/size][u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
﻿[/url]- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] (optional for animations)[/size]

[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[size=3]
[/size][u][size=5][b]Config
[/b][/size][/u][size=3]You can disable / enable animations by choosing "static" / "animated" respectively in the config.json. You can also disable decorations, reskins and everything else.[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Extra[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]The decorations are added as "bottom creatures" so they can be added multiple times to the same tank (if the tank is large enough), unlike the regular decorations (stone, seaweed & coral). They will take up space from other bottom creatures unfortunately. The items are added to the tanks in randomly generated locations, so getting them positioned neatly can take a few tries.[/size]
